hebrew: עֵת דּוֹדִים כַּלָּה בּוֹאִי לְגַנִּי פָּרְחָה הַגֶּפֶן הֵנֵצוּ הָרִמּוֹנִים
translation: It is a time for lovers. Come into my garden, my bride. The vines are blossoming. The pomegranates are budding.
information:
From a piyut based on Song of Songs, Chapter 6, written by Hayyim ben Sahel (10th century).

Traditional for the Moroccan Jewish community.
sourceNote: From a piyut based on Song of Songs, Chapter 6, written by Hayyim ben Sahel (10th century).
